title: 玩家控制受限，缺乏自由互动
description: 玩家只能进行有限的控制，如仅控制手部或按预设时机互动，无法自由移动或进行真正的互动。
evidence: All you can do is control hands...sometimes
einzig die Umsetzung lässt noch etwas an echter Interaktivität mangeln

Dinner Date on the other hand doesn't let you.For most of the game you pretty much sit at the table and tell him what to do. They do not give you the ability to give you the control over him at all, instead they let you select what to do with floating bubbles that tell you want to press.

evidence_items.quote: einzig die Umsetzung lässt noch etwas an echter Interaktivität mangeln
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏真正的互动性
evidence_items.quote_zh: 只是实现方式在真正的互动性上仍有所欠缺

evidence_items.quote: Dinner Date on the other hand doesn't let you.For most of the game you pretty much sit at the table and tell him what to do. They do not give you the ability to give you the control over him at all, instead they let you select what to do with floating bubbles that tell you want to press.
evidence_items.description: 玩家无法自由移动或控制角色，只能通过浮动气泡选择预设动作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 另一方面，《晚餐约会》不让你这么做。游戏的大部分时间里，你基本上就是坐在桌边告诉他该做什么。他们根本没有给你控制他的能力，而是让你通过漂浮的气泡来选择要做什么，气泡会告诉你该按什么。
